body.label: Effect
body.html: On a success, deal 1 weapon damage. If you have at least 2 Combo, choose one adjacent enemy; compare this Action against it and deal 1 weapon damage on a success.

surges.html: If you moved at least 3 units before this Action, deal +1 weapon damage.
Deal +1 weapon damage. If the target is already wounded, this costs 1 fewer Surge, minimum 1.

rider.title: BLITZ
rider.html: If this Action deals damage while you already have Combo, your next Prowess Action this turn gains 1 free Surge.
